items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), a template engine injection flaw allowing unauthenticated remote code execution with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler RCE)
items.summary: An out-of-band fix for the StyleSmuggler zero-day (CVE-2026-75650), this vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution with a CVSS score of 10.0 and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1 that allows attackers to switch customer sessions and access private data.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses fourteen vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48356 (PolyShell), an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload with a CVSS score of 9.6 that could lead to arbitrary code execution.
